text: Mentoring of the exhibition Som aquí by Sira Lobo, within the Il·luLola Festival.

The exhibition proposes a rediscovery of urban space by dismantling the landscape through illustration and rebuilding it through play. Making visible what is invisible, ephemeral and silent, the artist brings us closer to the nova esquerra de l'eixample neighbourhood, taking a walk up high to come down slowly and explore the way we look at it and inhabit it.
